# Business Analyst Onboarding – Week 1



## Role Summary

As a BA, you translate business needs into product requirements.



## Week 1 Goals

- Understand current product scope

- Review active user stories

- Learn to use Rally and Confluence



## Tools

- Rally (for requirements/user stories)

- Figma (design specs)

- Confluence (document workflows)



## Checklist

- [ ] Access granted to Rally

- [ ] Reviewed 3 past user stories

- [ ] Joined backlog refinement session



## Tips

- [ ] Reviewed 3 past user stories

- [ ] Joined backlog refinement session



## Tips

- Ask questions early and often

- Use the “INVEST” principle to assess story quality



## Contacts

- Product Owner: dana@company.com

# Developer Onboarding – Sprint 1



## Introduction

As a frontend developer, you will contribute to the marketplace UI.



## Goals

- Clone and run the dev environment

- Understand GitFlow and deployment pipelines

- Join code review sessions



## Tools

- VS Code

- GitHub

- Docker

- Vite + React



## Checklist

- [ ] `git clone` completed

- [ ] Docker running for API mocks

- [ ] Attended first FE Guild meeting



## Architecture

- [ ] Docker running for API mocks

- [ ] Attended first FE Guild meeting



## Architecture

Frontend repo uses atomic design. Each UI module is in its own folder under `/components`.



## Contacts

- Tech Lead: bob@company.com

# QA Onboarding - Week 1



## Overview

Welcome to the QA team. This week, you'll set up your environment, learn the test process, and review critical tools.



## Objectives

- Understand the product architecture

- Set up test environments

- Explore test case management tools



## Tools

- TestRail

- Postman

- Playwright



## Workflow

1. Review test strategy doc.

2. Join daily syncs.

3. Verify new builds in staging.



## Checklist

- [ ] Installed Playwright CLI

3. Verify new builds in staging.



## Checklist

- [ ] Installed Playwright CLI

- [ ] Access to staging/test servers

- [ ] Account created in TestRail



## Contacts

- QA Lead: alice@company.com

# Scrum Master Guide – First Month



## Purpose

Ensure team ceremonies and delivery flow are smooth and agile-compliant.



## Key Responsibilities

- Facilitate stand-ups, retros, planning, grooming

- Track team health and sprint velocity

- Shield team from external interruptions



## Tools

- Jira

- Confluence

- Miro



## Meetings

- Daily Standup: 10am

- Retro: End of Sprint, 30 mins

- Planning: Monday, 1 hour



## Checklist

- [ ] Jira dashboard created for team

- Planning: Monday, 1 hour



## Checklist

- [ ] Jira dashboard created for team

- [ ] Scrum board reviewed

- [ ] Stakeholder syncs scheduled



## Contacts

- Agile Coach: clara@company.com
